item.title: [Westminster City Council] Consent Item Pulled: Pass Councillor's Bill No. 54 on second reading to amend Title 5, Chapter 7; Title 8, Chapter 1; and to add Title 8, Chapter 14 of the Westminster Municipal Code concerning recycling, compost, and plastic regulations (Tabled 6-1)
